tasks.build: mkdir -p ./dist; rm -d ./dist/*; deno bundle --minify --output ./dist/mod.min.mjs ./src/mod.mjs; cp ./src/mod.d.mts ./src/jsr.json ./dist; mv ./dist/mod.min.mjs ./dist/mod.min.mjs.tmp; echo '/* @ts-self-types="./mod.d.mts" */' > ./dist/mod.min.mjs; cat ./dist/mod.min.mjs.tmp >> ./dist/mod.min.mjs; rm ./dist/mod.min.mjs.tmp; cp ./README.md ./dist/README.md
